feat(camellia): add auth session baseline

Summary:
- add a real camellia staging login flow with redirect handling
- persist token, user, and access data in local storage with cleanup helpers
- inject Authorization and x-app headers through the shared API client
- protect console routes and clear the session on 401, 403, or KICK_OUT
- add a staging auth smoke script for login and invalid-session coverage

Rationale:
- DAM-16 needs a reusable auth/session foundation before more admin pages
  migrate into camellia
- keeping session, route guards, and API authorization centralized reduces
  follow-up duplication across later tickets

Tests:
- pnpm run check:camellia
- node scripts/camellia-auth-smoke.mjs
